messages:
Maya Patel: Hey team, enterprise customer 'BrightFind' opened a P1 — their rerank calls to /v1/rerank are getting 429s and some unexpected empty results since ~2026-03-14T11:07Z. They say generation endpoints are fine. Can we triage? They reported ~15% of rerank calls failing across multiple regions.

Liam Chen: Looking into logs now. I can already see a spike of 429 responses for the rerank service starting at 2026-03-14T11:05:22Z. Error body is `{"error":{"message":"Rate limit exceeded","type":"rate_limit_exceeded"}}`. Hoping it's quota config related rather than customer traffic pattern.

Sarah Gomez: FYI there was a config change in infra at 11:03 (deploy 2026-03-14T11:03) that consolidated per-endpoint token buckets for embeddings + rerank into a shared bucket to reduce cold-start thrash. Could be related. PR #4978.

Maya Patel: Customer says they haven't changed anything on their side. Their agent ID is acct:brightfind-prod. They also pasted a sample request id: rq_0a3b6c... (attached).

Liam Chen: Reproduced locally using their account token. Quick repro command:

```
curl -i -X POST https://api.redwood.inference/v1/rerank \ 
  -H "Authorization: Bearer sk_brightfind-prod" \ 
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \ 
  -d '{"query":"best laptops 2026","documents":["doc1","doc2","doc3"]}'
```

Response after the spike: HTTP/1.1 429 Too Many Requests
```
{"error":{"message":"Rate limit exceeded for rerank (shared bucket)","code":"rerank_rate_limit_exceeded"}}
```

Headers include: `X-RateLimit-Limit: 30`, `X-RateLimit-Remaining: 0`, `Retry-After: 60`. The bucket looks like a very low default for sudden bursts.

Raj Singh: I pulled infra metrics — the shared bucket was exhausted because embedding ingestion and a single large client (BrightFind) both hit the merged bucket. The merge halved effective throughput for rerank compared to before. Rerank calls are smaller but more frequent; embeddings are larger but fewer. Merging them created contention.

Maya Patel: Customer timeline: they saw 429s start exactly at 11:05 and spike for ~7 minutes. They had some parallelization changes last week (increasing concurrency to 50), but claim they’re within their historical usage.

Liam Chen: Two things I noticed: 1) their SDK was calling rerank in parallel with embedding generation in the same request flow which now both consume the shared bucket. 2) The SDK accidentally omits `model` param on rerank, which causes server to select `rerank-large-v2` fallback in some cases — that variant counts as 3x toward bucket consumption due to internal weight. So their apparent stable call volume became heavier post-deploy.

Sarah Gomez: Ok that matches the root cause hypothesis: config change (shared bucket) + client concurrency + fallback to heavy model = burst exhaustion -> 429s.

Maya Patel: Customer asks for immediate mitigation; they need rerank traffic unthrottled while we sort the config. Can we do a temporary quota bump for acct:brightfind-prod? Also want suggested client-side mitigations.

Liam Chen: I can apply a temporary policy to exclude their token from the shared bucket and restore the old per-endpoint behavior for that account. Will do a 30-minute exception now.

infra-bot: Applied temporary rate-limit override for token=sk_brightfind-prod; policy_id=rl-override-1934; expires=2026-03-14T12:05:00Z. Action by: liam.

Maya Patel: I told the customer we've applied a temporary override and to retry. They've confirmed initial retries are succeeding (no more 429s) and latency is back to normal. :thumbsup:

Raj Singh: For longer-term fix we should either revert the merge or implement weighted buckets properly so rerank has a guaranteed share. Also add a guard that prevents the server from choosing a heavier fallback model when the client omitted `model`. That fallback behavior is risky under quota constraints.

Sarah Gomez: Agreed. I'll open a patch ticket: revert-or-weighted-buckets. Also PR to change default `X-RateLimit-Limit` for rerank to 120 for hosted tenants while we test changes.

Liam Chen: I'll also push a small server change to emit clearer metrics: `rerank_bucket_pressure{account=\"acct:...\"}` and surface per-endpoint consumed_units in the dashboard. That should help detect similar issues before customers escalate.

Maya Patel: For the customer-facing side, here's the guidance I sent them: 1) Reduce client concurrency for rerank calls (suggested concurrency 8). 2) Explicitly set the `model` param in rerank calls to avoid heavy fallbacks. 3) Implement exponential backoff around 429s and respect `Retry-After`. 4) We'll monitor their traffic for the next 24h.

BrightFind (via Maya): Thanks — the temporary fix looks good. We'll set `model` explicitly and roll concurrency back while you update configs. Please keep us posted.

Raj Singh: Note for post-mortem: root cause = infra config change (merged buckets) + client pattern (simultaneous embedding + rerank) + server fallback to heavier model. Action items assigned:
- Sarah: revert-or-weighted-buckets ticket + increase rerank default limit (prod config) (ETA 48h).
- Liam: emit bucket pressure metrics + patch fallback logic (ETA 72h).
- Maya: follow up with BrightFind, confirm SDK model param fix deployed.
- Ops: consider retrospective change window rules for infra config that affects quotas.

billing-bot: Notified billing team of temporary override for acct:brightfind-prod; override will not change billing but may affect quota metering.

Maya Patel: Closing loop — BrightFind confirmed no regression after override and will implement client changes. I'll keep an eye on logs and update thread if anything else comes up. Thanks all.

Liam Chen: Leaving a short playbook note in docs: troubleshooting rerank 429s — check shared-bucket pressure, verify model param, check for parallel embedding calls, check X-RateLimit headers. I'll link from support KB.

Sarah Gomez: Creating incident postmortem draft now. Will assign owners and add timeline.

Maya Patel: End of thread.
